lines: Worship, worshipper, worshipped — what talk of difference here, in the unsurpassed?
Transition indeed — of whom, by whom made, who walks the entry-course?
This Māyā — no different from consciousness-nonduality — stands as other, though different. Alas.
Everything is pure own-experience-nature. Vain thought — do not.
sanskrit_cite: pūjapūjakapūjya bhedasaraṇiḥ keyam kathā anuttare saṃkrāmaḥ kila kasya kena vidadhe ko vā praveśakramaḥ māyeyam | na cidadvayāt paratayā bhinnā api aho vartate sarvam svānubhavasvabhāvavimalaṃ cintāṃ vṛthā mā kṛthāḥ
